title: One card per tab
body: Each card says what its tab holds and where that comes from — kept by the owner, mocked until a feed exists, or deliberately unreadable from here. No card carries a figure: a card is JSON baked at build time and could only ever show a value that was true when it was typed, and two of these tabs have nothing to count at all, where a zero would claim a measurement nobody took. Tap a card to read the real thing.

items.title: Wallet
items.subtitle: Pay · IDs · Vcards · Events
items.body: Kept by the owner, and the only tab here with records of its own. Payment cards, identity and civil documents, contact cards, and the tickets, passes and bookings under Events — one JSON file per record, shipped as assets and browsed as folders, so the tab works with no network and no account.

items.title: Docs
items.subtitle: One folder per life-admin domain
items.body: Empty here, and meant to be. Housing, vehicle, insurance and the rest are folders, not records: nothing about a contract, a policy or a payment is stored on the phone, so the tab has no documents to count and each card opens the file app at the matching folder instead.

meta.label: Source
meta.value: none here — the files live in Cloud IDE

items.title: Fin
items.subtitle: Acct · Budget · Portfolio
items.body: Mocked, not measured. The accounting dashboard draws three views of one question, but the figures behind them are still the beta fixture libs:fin was written against rather than a live aggregator feed — so read that screen as the shape of the answer, not the answer. Opens on Acct.

meta.label: Source
meta.value: ui.myfin_mock — placeholder, no live feed yet

items.title: Vault
items.subtitle: Credentials
items.body: Empty by design, and not waiting for a source to arrive. Passwords and identities live in Cloud Vault, which holds the only copy and the only key; Cloud Me never reads them, because counting them would mean unlocking the vault from here.
